backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing agriculture venture platform with access control, storage mixins, group creation, and auto-generated crop milestones.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing feature evidence, related files, components, tests, and confidence for money-model and frontend changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of many frontend files and their roles in routing, UI, and money-handling logic.
frontend/index.html: HTML root page loading the React frontend via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app controlling authentication, routing, and page rendering with profile setup modal and group navigation.
frontend/src/components/AddContributionD: Dialog for creating contributions, parsing money input to cents, and submitting via React Query.
frontend/src/components/AddExpenseDialog: Dialog for submitting expenses with money parsing, image upload, and category selection.
frontend/src/components/AddMilestoneDial: Dialog form for creating a milestone with name, description, date, and optional image, submitting via useAddMilestone.
frontend/src/components/AddPlannedPaymen: Dialog to create a planned payment for a group member, handling amount parsing, due date, and member selection.
frontend/src/components/AddRevenueDialog: Dialog for adding revenue entries with source, amount, date, and description, submitted through useAddRevenue.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupDialo: Dialog to create a new venture group with crop templates, contribution settings, dates, and admin identity.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing copyright and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with navigation, authentication handling, group breadcrumbs, and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/MyPlannedPayment: Displays the user’s planned payments, grouping them by status and showing loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/PayoutCalculator: Calculates and displays payout suggestions for group members, including totals and paid status, with admin payout recording.
frontend/src/components/PlannedPaymentsS: Shows a group’s planned payments by status with admin controls for adding new payments.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for collecting and saving a new user’s profile details such as name, country, and phone.
frontend/src/components/ReceiptModal.tsx: Modal for displaying a receipt image with options to download or close.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, including login, logout, and identity loading from storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data, including user profiles, venture groups, contributions, and monetary normalization.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global background and text styles.
frontend/src/lib/money.ts: Offers formatting, parsing, and validation helpers for monetary values, delegating all logic to moneyModel for consistency.
frontend/src/lib/moneyMath.ts: Implements arithmetic utilities for sums and percentage calculations using normalized cent values.
frontend/src/lib/moneyModel.ts: Central money model controlling normalization, formatting, and parsing of backend monetary amounts with support for global and per‑group modes.
Empty placeholder file for future expense normalization logic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Contributions.tsx: UI page for viewing, filtering, and deleting user contributions within selected groups, with totals computed from normalized cents.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays user‑specific venture group stats, planned payments, and returns using data from React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDashboard.tsx: Displays a group's financial stats, milestones, activity, and progress with admin controls and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetail.tsx: Shows detailed group data including contributions, expenses, revenues, milestones, and allows adding or deleting items.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing homepage with hero content, feature highlights, and login CTA using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Milestones.tsx: Lists milestones for user-related groups with filtering, status display, and group selection.
frontend/src/pages/MyGroups.tsx: Displays user's groups, searchable lists of admin/member/available groups, and supports joining or navigating to groups.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters from query or hash, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes project state and requirements for fixing monetary scaling issues, including existing features, new requests, and architectural notes.
